title: Sr Content Writer
description:
Job Summary 
 We are looking for a content writer who can write for software buyers, not a generic blogger. You will create content that speaks to our ideal customer profiles (CTOs, CIOs, product heads, and founders) and helps move them from awareness to enquiry. Experience writing for the healthcare domain is a strong advantage. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Write blogs, whitepapers, case studies, ebooks, service pages, landing pages, and email copy for our software and IT services offerings Understand our ICPs, their pain points, and buying journey, and write content tailored to each segment Research industry topics (healthcare, Fintech, cloud, AI, mobile and web development, DevOps, digital transformation) and turn technical inputs into clear, persuasive content Create SEO-optimised content with keyword research, on-page optimisation, and proper structure Work with developers, solution architects, and the sales team to collect technical inputs and client success stories Edit and proofread content for quality, accuracy, and brand tone Track content performance (traffic, rankings, leads) and improve based on data Keep up with trends in the software industry and in healthcare technology 

 Required Skills and Qualifications 
 3-5 years of content writing experience in an IT company, software company, or IT services industry Proven experience writing B2B content such as whitepapers, case studies, and thought leadership articles Prior experience writing on healthcare or health-tech topics (EHR/EMR, telemedicine, HIPAA, digital health) Strong English writing, editing, and research skills Working knowledge of SEO and tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Surfer Ability to understand technical concepts and explain them simply Portfolio or live links to published B2B or technical work (mandatory) Bachelor s degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, IT, or a related field 

 Good to Have 
 Experience writing for other verticals such as fintech, logistics, retail, or edtech Basic knowledge of WordPress and content calendars Familiarity with AI writing tools used responsibly, with strong human editing Basic understanding of LinkedIn and social media content for B2B

title: Long-Form Content Writer - AI & Enterprise Technology
description:
class="description"> Job Overview This role is primarily about writing . We are looking for someone with outstanding English writing ability, strong research skills, excellent judgment, and the ability to develop a clear point of view and narrative around a subject. Experience in technical writing within the AI, enterprise infrastructure, or enterprise IT highly desired. The role will cover much more than blog posts. You may work on long-form articles, thought leadership, whitepapers, research-driven content, industry reports, case studies, website content, and other editorial and marketing assets. Key Responsibilities Write high-quality long-form content across AI, enterprise technology, infrastructure, and related topics. Research unfamiliar subjects thoroughly and develop a strong understanding before writing. Produce long-form articles that are informative, engaging, structured, and original. Develop thought-leadership content for technology and business audiences. Write whitepapers, research-driven reports, industry guides, and educational resources. Develop case studies and customer-focused stories. Create website and landing-page content when required. Write content for senior technology decision-makers, business leaders, IT professionals, and broader technology audiences. Turn complex ideas into clear and compelling narratives without unnecessarily simplifying the subject. Interview or collaborate with subject-matter experts when deeper technical insight is required. Identify interesting angles, trends, questions, and stories within broader technology topics. Adapt writing style and structure depending on the audience, subject, and content format. Edit and refine content for clarity, flow, accuracy, originality, and readability. Work with the marketing and SEO teams to align content with search intent and broader content objectives. What Were Looking For Native English-speaking candidates only. Exceptional written English and a strong command of grammar, vocabulary, structure, and tone. Demonstrated ability to write high-quality long-form content. Strong storytelling and narrative skills. Ability to make complex subjects interesting and easy to understand. Excellent research skills and intellectual curiosity. Ability to develop original ideas, angles, and perspectives rather than simply rewriting existing information. Strong editing and self-editing skills. Ability to write for different audiences and content formats. Strong attention to detail and factual accuracy. Ability to learn technical subjects quickly and communicate what you have learned clearly. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment. Content You May Work On Depending on business requirements, your work may include: Long-form articles Thought-leadership pieces Whitepapers Industry reports Research-driven content Technology guides Case studies Website and landing-page content Educational resources Executive-level content Technical and business content Campaign and marketing content Technical Topics You may write about subjects including: Artificial intelligence AI infrastructure AI data centers AI factories GPU computing Cloud infrastructure Enterprise IT Data centers Cybersecurity Emerging technology Enterprise hardware and services Preferred Qualifications Portfolio demonstrating exceptional long-form writing. Experience writing technology, business, enterprise, or B2B content. Experience creating whitepapers, reports, case studies, or thought-leadership content. Basic understanding of SEO, search intent, headings, content structure, and keyword usage. Experience working with subject-matter experts. Familiarity with AI-assisted research and writing tools. Experience writing for enterprise or professional audiences. What We Value Most Writing quality comes first. We are looking for someone who can take a subject, do the research, find the interesting story or insight within it, and produce writing that people actually want to read. Strong technical knowledge is useful, but exceptional writing ability, curiosity, research skills, and editorial judgment are more important.
